title.narrative: Danmission's inter-religious dialogue and diapracsis for peace in Zanzibar

description.narrative:
The goal of the project is to educate young girls and women in order to strengthen their confidence and self-image. Furthermore, the goal is to educate young people to be positive change agents for peace.
Continuation of the sowing school where marginalized girls can get an education in crafting.
Continuation of the Zanzibar Interfaith Centre (ZANZIC) where young people are educated to be positive change agents for peace.

The grant is given to the organisation due to their application to the COVID-19 Emergency Pool (Nødpulje) in order for the organisation to continue their skills development activities in India. Due to COVID-19 restrictions, planned development activities are in risk of closure, which would negatively affect results.
